interpretation.confirmed: Solids 1 and 3 are the mold halves; 2, 4, 5 are tiny separate bodies at the thumb proximal region. Extra shells 7, 8, 9 have identical rounded-eight-decimal tessellation hashes and depict a fingertip-like shell with connection ears.
interpretation.inferred: Geometry is associated with a hand mold; the tiny solids plausibly result from splitting/Boolean construction, including possible isolated cores or residual slivers.
interpretation.unknown: No native feature history establishes the original Boolean operands or the intended ownership/function of the tiny solids. No complete hand is present as one of the five explicit solid bodies.
